title: How UPPAbaby Consolidated 29 Sites into Seven Global Storefronts on Shopware
excerpt: Case study we wrote for Shopware. Covers how premium baby-gear brand UPPAbaby consolidated 29 localized sites into 7 global storefronts on self-hosted Shopware 6, built by NuLogic.
content: Content Cucumber wrote this customer case study for Shopware. We interviewed UPPAbaby and NuLogic (the implementation agency), gathered the technical and business details, and structured the narrative around UPPAbaby's move from WooCommerce to self-hosted Shopware 6 across its global markets.
challenge:
Shopware needed a customer case study showing how UPPAbaby, a premium baby-gear brand with global ambitions, rebuilt its commerce on Shopware 6. The story had to translate a sprawling international setup into a clear, prospect-facing narrative: a self-hosted platform, a 29-site-to-7-channel consolidation, and flexible payment routing by market.

It had to land for two audiences at once: multi-market brands weighing a replatform, and Shopware's own sales team using it as proof in deals.
approach:
We interviewed UPPAbaby and NuLogic (the implementation agency partner) to gather the technical, operational, and business details.

From the source material we structured the narrative around the limitation that triggered the migration (WooCommerce straining under UPPAbaby's international demand), the requirements that ruled out CommerceTools, Shopify, and Salesforce Commerce Cloud, the build, and the outcomes. We surfaced the metrics that mattered (29 localized sites consolidated into 7 global sales channels managed from one backend, an eight-month migration with no lengthy discovery phase, and flexible payment routing with BlueSnap for favorable B2B rates).

Delivered as a polished case study ready for Shopware's content library and sales enablement.
results: Written for Shopware's customer library. It tells how UPPAbaby moved off WooCommerce onto self-hosted Shopware 6 with NuLogic, launching a consolidated global presence in eight months, unifying 29 localized sites into 7 sales channels with consistent branding and data, and giving its in-house PHP team ownership of ongoing customization without heavy retraining.

The piece covers how the premium baby-gear brand moved off WooCommerce onto self-hosted Shopware 6, consolidating 29 localized sites into 7 global sales channels from a single backend, migrating in eight months, with flexible payment routing by market. Shopware is the client. UPPAbaby is the customer featured in the story.
